content: I'll split this research bead into 4 focused, sequential child beads that can be independently completed.

args.command:
bead create --title "Locate aider glob pattern implementation" --description "Find and examine where in the aider codebase glob patterns are parsed and processed.

Tasks:
- Search the aider codebase for glob-related code (ripgrep integration, glob pattern parsing)
- Identify what library/implementation aider uses for glob matching
- Find configuration or validation code for glob patterns

Acceptance criteria:
- File paths and line numbers for glob pattern handling code
- Identification of the underlying glob library (ripgrep, glob.glob, custom, etc.)
- Understanding of the pattern entry point (CLI args, config file, etc.)" --label split-child
args.description: Create first child bead about locating glob implementation

args.command:
bead create --title "Test basic glob patterns in aider" --description "Verify that standard glob patterns work correctly in aider.

Tasks:
- Test common glob patterns (*, ?, [], [!], etc.)
- Test path separator behavior (/ vs \\\\)
- Test case sensitivity on different platforms
- Test recursive patterns without **

Acceptance criteria:
- Test results showing which basic patterns work
- Documentation of any quirks or deviations from standard glob
- Evidence of actual behavior (screenshots, logs, or test runs)" --label split-child
args.description: Create second child bead about testing basic glob patterns

args.command:
bead create --title "Test advanced glob features in aider" --description "Verify advanced glob features like tilde expansion and double-star globbing.

Tasks:
- Test tilde (~) expansion to home directory
- Test double-star (**) recursive globbing
- Test brace expansion if supported
- Test character class ranges ([a-z], [0-9])

Acceptance criteria:
- Clear evidence of which advanced features are supported
- Test results showing ~ expansion behavior
- Test results showing ** recursive matching depth
- Documentation of any limitations or edge cases

Depends on: agentscr-b4e7e169 (basic glob tests must pass first)" --label split-child
args.description: Create third child bead about testing advanced glob features

args.command:
bead create --title "Document aider glob pattern syntax" --description "Write comprehensive documentation of aider's glob pattern syntax based on research findings.

Tasks:
- Compile findings from all prior research beads
- Write clear documentation with examples
- Include supported vs unsupported features
- Reference source code locations
- Add practical examples for common use cases

Acceptance criteria:
- Complete documentation file (markdown or similar)
- Clear examples of supported patterns
- Explicit list of unsupported features
- Source code references for verification
- Practical usage examples

Depends on: agentscr-087352ad (must complete all testing first)" --label split-child
